input.encoding: [ni, nj, nk, nl, nm] for the three source matrix multiplication passes

output.meaning: sum of final G elements in row-major order after E=A*B, F=C*D, and G=E*F

source_bound.description: PolyBench/C defaults to binary64. A[i][k]=((i*k+1) mod ni)/(5*ni); B[k][j]=((k*(j+1)+2) mod nj)/(5*nj); C[i][j]=(i*(j+3) mod nl)/(5*nl); D[i][j]=((i*(j+2)+2) mod nk)/(5*nk). The first pass initializes E[i][j]=0 and accumulates A[i][k]*B[k][j] for k ascending to nk. The second initializes F[i][j]=0 and accumulates C[i][k]*D[k][j] for k ascending to nm. The third initializes G[i][j]=0 and accumulates E[i][k]*F[k][j] for k ascending to nj. The suite reduces final G row-major. The header defaults to LARGE_DATASET (NI=800,NJ=900,NK=1000,NL=1100,NM=1200); suite dimensions are bounded to 1..16.
